svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Many learners, one model
svg.desc: Six learners, each holding a different local data distribution, send compressed updates to a robust aggregator and gossip with their neighbours. One learner sends a corrupted update, which the robust median down-weights. Each learner has local data, local compute, a communication budget, and a sparse set of neighbours; client drift, failures, adversarial participants, and stale information are what can go wrong.
svg.text: local updates · limited communication · robust aggregation · consensus

g.text: each node: a different local data distribution
AGGREGATE ROBUSTLY · COMMUNICATE SPARINGLY · CONVERGE DESPITE HETEROGENEITY
